verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev docs say the installer lets you "Pick the skills and agents you use" and "Install the ones you want," and it writes editable files into your project, so selective install is supported. The Claude Code plugin route, by contrast, installs the whole set as a read-only bundle. Missing for 10: details of the selection mechanism (e.g., the exact per-skill npx command or flags), documentation of whether dependencies between skills such as setup-matt-pocock-skills are handled when installing a subset, and independent hands-on confirmation.
